text:
pagerbot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-2026-4532 - embeddings-service EU region high error rate (>10% 5xx). Severity: P1. Link: https://pagerduty.local/INC-2026-4532 - please ack and claim ownership.

incident-bot: Alert summary: spikes started ~1768889950. 503 from embedder-v2; queue depth 420. Recent deploy: embedder:v2.2.3-qa-hotfix (rolling since 1768889400).

devon: acked and taking. jumping onto bridge, creating a short bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-4532 . @maria please monitor customer pings, assigning comms.

maria: acknowledged. standing by for customer comms. any idea if this is hosted-only or dedicated tenants impacted?

devon: preliminary look -> hosted EU only, looks like KV cache mismatch after quantization change. plan: rollback embedder to v2.2.1 and drain queue. executing: kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embedder embedder=embedder:v2.2.1 && rollout status deploy/embedder

jason: pinging runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/embedder-503s. Suggest temporary rate-limit on /v1/embeddings EU edge while we rollback: posting curl to edge-rate-limiter.

lina: tailing logs -> seeing restarts, 5xx count decreasing slightly. starting a live grep for "kv-cache-evict" to verify correlation.

devon: rollback initiated. pods restarting (3/6). queue depth -> 210, error rate -> 6.8%.

pagerbot: Page acknowledged by devon. Escalation timer paused.

devon: restart finished on majority (5/6). error rate down to 2.4%, queue depth 78. continuing to monitor for 10m.

maria: sent initial customer note to affected hosted accounts via ops-signal: "We observed elevated embedding errors in EU between 17:45-18:05 UTC. We mitigated via rollback. We'll follow up with RCA if needed." (internal link to outbound draft: https://comms.redwood/drafts/INC-2026-4532)

jason: I've queued a temporary fallback route to a smaller embedding model (embedder:v2-compat) if error rate rises above 5% again. Will leave in place for 1 hour.

devon: handing off longer-term watch to morning oncall at 1800Z. @jason please take if it recurs. I'll annotate incident with steps and links on the bridge notes.

jason: happy to take. also adding a short metric alert: if 5xx > 4% for 5m post-rollback -> auto-trigger scaled buffer and notify SRE.

devon: marking as resolved in PagerDuty pending 10m cooldown. will close if stable.

incident-bot: Pager duty update: status=acknowledged -> monitoring. awaiting final resolution.

pagerbot: Page closed by devon at 1768891002 (no further escalation).
